#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.WebSockets;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Channels;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Soenneker.Extensions.Task;
using Soenneker.Extensions.ValueTask;
using Soenneker.Extensions.Object;
using Soenneker.Asyncs.Semaphores;
namespace @@NAMESPACE@@;

public abstract class JsonRpcTransport : IJsonRpcTransport
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, TaskCompletionSource<JsonElement>> _pending = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Channel<JsonElement> _incoming = Channel.CreateUnbounded<JsonElement>(new UnboundedChannelOptions { SingleReader = true, SingleWriter = true });
    private readonly AsyncSemaphore _writeLock = new(1, 1);
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _lifetime = new();
    private Exception? _closed;
    private int _disposed;
    public Task Completion { get; private set; } = Task.CompletedTask;
    protected void Start() => Completion = ReadLoop();
    protected abstract ValueTask<string?> ReadMessage(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    protected abstract ValueTask WriteMessage(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> message, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    protected virtual bool LineDelimited => false;
    protected abstract ValueTask Close();

    public async ValueTask<JsonElement?> Send(JsonElement request, bool notification, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        ThrowIfClosed();
        if (notification) { await WriteResponse(request, cancellationToken).NoSync(); return null; }
        string id = request.GetProperty("id").GetString() ?? throw new ArgumentException("Outgoing request IDs must be strings.");
        var pending = new TaskCompletionSource<JsonElement>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        if (!_pending.TryAdd(id, pending)) throw new ArgumentException("Duplicate outgoing request ID.");
        try
        {
            ThrowIfClosed();
            await WriteResponse(request, cancellationToken).NoSync();
            return await pending.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken).NoSync();
        }
        finally { _pending.TryRemove(id, out _); }
    }
    private void ThrowIfClosed()
    {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0, this);
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _closed) is { } error) throw new IOException("RPC connection is closed.", error);
    }
    public async ValueTask WriteResponse(JsonElement response, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ThrowIfClosed();
        using var linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken, _lifetime.Token);
        using var lease = await _writeLock.Acquire(linked.Token).NoSync();
        try
        {
            ThrowIfClosed();
            using var buffer = new PooledJsonBuffer();
            using (var writer = new Utf8JsonWriter(buffer)) response.WriteTo(writer);
            if (LineDelimited) { buffer.GetSpan(1)[0] = (byte)'\n'; buffer.Advance(1); }
            await WriteMessage(buffer.WrittenMemory, linked.Token).NoSync();
        }
        catch (Exception error)
        {
            // A partial frame cannot safely be retried on the same connection.
            Terminate(error);
            throw;
        }
    }
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<JsonElement> ReadMessages([EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await foreach (var message in _incoming.Reader.ReadAllAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false)) yield return message;
    }
    private async Task ReadLoop()
    {
        Exception? failure = null;
        try
        {
            while (await ReadMessage(_lifetime.Token).NoSync() is { } text)
            {
                using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(text);
                JsonElement message = document.RootElement.Clone();
                if (message.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("RPC frames must contain an object.");
                var names = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                foreach (var property in message.EnumerateObject())
                    if (!names.Add(property.Name)) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Duplicate envelope member: " + property.Name);
                if (message.TryGetProperty("method", out _))
                    await _incoming.Writer.WriteAsync(message, _lifetime.Token).NoSync();
                else if (message.TryGetProperty("id", out var id))
                {
                    if (id.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                    {
                        if (_pending.TryRemove(id.GetString()!, out var pending)) pending.TrySetResult(message);
                        // Replies arriving after cancellation are intentionally ignored.
                    }
                    else if (id.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null)
                    {
                        throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Received an uncorrelated null-ID RPC error: " + message.GetRawText());
                    }
                    else throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Invalid response ID.");
                }
                else throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Incoming envelope has neither method nor ID.");
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (_lifetime.IsCancellationRequested) { }
        catch (Exception error) { failure = error; throw; }
        finally
        {
            Terminate(failure ?? new EndOfStreamException("RPC peer disconnected."));
            _incoming.Writer.TryComplete(failure);
        }
    }
    private void Terminate(Exception error)
    {
        Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _closed, error, null);
        foreach (var entry in _pending)
            if (_pending.TryRemove(entry.Key, out var pending)) pending.TrySetException(error);
        _lifetime.Cancel();
    }
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) != 0) return;
        Terminate(new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(JsonRpcTransport)));
        try { await Completion.NoSync(); }
        finally
        {
            using var lease = await _writeLock.Acquire().NoSync();
            await Close().NoSync();
            // Semaphore/CTS remain usable for concurrent callers already unwinding.
        }
    }
}
